code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Separator rows/columns are uniform lines, distinguishing the repeated panels.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] not in (0, 8)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] not in (0, 8)]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            cells = [grid[r][c]
                     for r in range(row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1])
                     for c in range(col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1])]
            background = next((v for v in cells if v != 8), 0)
            row.append(1 if cells.count(8) > 1 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
